title: Inter-NIT table-tennis medals
summary: The NIT Raipur newsletter names Sayon Pramanik as gold medallist in table-tennis singles and doubles, and bronze medallist in mixed doubles, at the 2024 Inter-NIT sports meet. It also reports a bronze in the team event.

title: NIT-Raipur lifts overall trophy in table tennis
summary: The report names Sayon Pramanik of NIT Raipur as runner-up in the men’s singles event at the All-India Inter-NIT Faculty and Staff Tournament. This item concerns a sporting achievement during his time at NIT Raipur.

title: Inter-NIT table-tennis silver medal
